<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-config-docs.ts from schemas/config.schema.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Project configuration lives in `.wombo-combo/config.json`. Every option is optional; omitted options use
the defaults below. The `$schema` key is accepted for editor validation.

## Top-level options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | string |  | JSON Schema reference (for editor validation) |
| `tasksDir` | string | `"tasks"` | Directory name for task files relative to .wombo-combo/ |
| `archiveDir` | string | `"archive"` | Directory name for archived task files relative to .wombo-combo/ |
| `tasksFile` | string |  | DEPRECATED: Legacy single-file path. Use tasksDir instead. |
| `archiveFile` | string |  | DEPRECATED: Legacy single-file path. Use archiveDir instead. |
| `baseBranch` | string | `"main"` | Base branch to create feature branches from |
| `devMode` | boolean | `false` | Developer mode: enables hidden features like fake task seeding (F key) in TUI. Can also be enabled via --dev CLI flag. |
| `agentProfiles` | object |  | Named agent profiles: harness + binary + model + provider + account env references. Never put secrets here. |

## `build`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `build.command` | string | `"npm run build"` | Build command to run in worktrees |
| `build.timeout` | integer | `300000` | Build timeout in milliseconds |
| `build.artifactDir` | string | `"dist"` | Build artifact directory |

## `install`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `install.command` | string | `"npm install"` | Install command to run in worktrees |
| `install.timeout` | integer | `120000` | Install timeout in milliseconds |

## `git`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `git.branchPrefix` | string | `"feature/"` | Branch name prefix for feature branches |
| `git.worktreePrefix` | string | `"woco-"` | Worktree directory name prefix |
| `git.remote` | string | `"origin"` | Git remote name |
| `git.mergeStrategy` | string | `"--no-ff"` | Merge strategy flag (e.g. --no-ff, --ff-only) |

## `agent`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent.bin` | string \| null | `null` | Path to agent binary (null = auto-detect) |
| `agent.name` | string | `"generalist-agent"` | Agent name to pass via --agent flag |
| `agent.configFiles` | string[] | `[".opencode/","opencode.json","AGENTS.md"]` | Config files/dirs to copy into worktrees |

## `portless`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `portless.enabled` | boolean | `true` | Whether portless is enabled for agent worktrees |
| `portless.bin` | string \| null | `null` | Path to portless binary (null = auto-detect) |
| `portless.proxyPort` | integer | `1355` | Proxy port (portless default is 1355) |
| `portless.https` | boolean | `false` | Whether to use HTTPS mode |

## `backup`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `backup.maxBackups` | integer | `5` | Maximum number of timestamped backups to keep Minimum: `0`. |

## `defaults`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaults.maxConcurrent` | integer | `10` | Max concurrent agents (0 = unlimited) Minimum: `0`. |
| `defaults.maxRetries` | integer | `5` | Max retries per agent Minimum: `0`. |

| Option | Type | Default | Description |

## `postMerge`

Changelog generation and GitHub PR publication after successful merges

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `postMerge.prMode` | string | `"skip"` | open = ready PR, draft = draft PR, skip = no GitHub publication Values: `open`, `draft`, `skip`. |
| `postMerge.prBaseBranch` | string \| null | `null` | PR target branch; null = the configured remote's default branch |
| `postMerge.changelog` | boolean | `true` | Append a CHANGELOG.md entry after successful merges (independent of prMode) |

## `replay`

Retention of recorded agent session replays (.wombo-combo/replays/), applied after each execution finishes

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `replay.keepPerTask` | integer | `20` | Executions kept per task (newest first) Minimum: `0`. |
| `replay.maxAgeDays` | number \| null | `null` | Delete replays older than this many days; null = no age limit |
| `replay.maxTotalMB` | number \| null | `null` | Total size cap of all replays in MB (oldest removed first); null = no cap |

## `team`

Multi-developer coordination: git-tracked task claims (.wombo-combo/claims/) so teammates do not work on the same task

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `team.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Enable task claims; the daemon skips tasks claimed by another developer |
| `team.owner` | string \| null | `null` | Claim owner identity; null = git config user.email |
| `team.claimTtlHours` | number | `24` | Hours until a claim expires and can be taken over |

## `comments`

Task and quest comments (.wombo-combo/comments/): recent comments in agent prompts and optional daemon lifecycle comments

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comments.enabled` | boolean | `true` | Include recent comments in agent prompts and tell agents how to leave one |
| `comments.promptMaxItems` | integer | `10` | Maximum number of recent comments per task or quest in the agent prompt Minimum: `1`. |
| `comments.promptMaxChars` | integer | `4000` | Maximum total characters of comment text in the agent prompt (oldest dropped first) Minimum: `1`. |
| `comments.autoLifecycle` | boolean | `false` | Daemon posts system comments on task lifecycle events (started, failed, merged, retried) |

## `sync`

Integrations that sync woco data with external services

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sync.github.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Master switch for the automatic behaviour (write-through push, daemon cycle) |
| `sync.github.mode` | string | `"manual"` | manual: only explicit woco sync commands. auto: push changed items right after they are written, and run pull+push every intervalSeconds in the daemon Values: `manual`, `auto`. |
| `sync.github.repo` | string \| object |  | Repository to sync with, as "owner/name" or { owner, name, host }. Default: the git origin remote |
| `sync.github.intervalSeconds` | number | `60` | Seconds between automatic pull+push cycles (daemon and woco sync watch) Minimum: `15`. |
| `sync.github.pushOnWrite` | boolean | `true` | In auto mode, push an item in the background right after a local change to it |
| `sync.github.pull` | boolean | `true` | In auto mode, cycles also pull remote changes before pushing |
